name: Masked Title Flip
description: A GSAP text reveal for React: a big headline zooms up from 45% while its lines rise one by one out of masks, each sliding in from alternate sides on a sharp ease that settles slowly. Click it and the lines drop away one by one while a second headline rises in their place; click again to swap back. Plays each time it scrolls into view.

props.name: lines
props.description: The headline, one entry per line.

props.name: altLines
props.description: The second headline it flips to.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for each line to rise in.

props.name: scaleFrom
props.description: The whole headline grows from this scale as the lines rise (1 = no zoom).

props.name: trigger
props.description: 'view' plays each time it scrolls into view; 'mount' once, at once.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, when it isn't the window.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the headline: font, size, line height, alignment.
